name: Druid of Purification
oracle_text: When this creature enters, starting with you, each player may choose an artifact or enchantment you don't control. Destroy each permanent chosen this way.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, starting with you, each player may choose an artifact or enchantment you don't control. Destroy each permanent chosen this way.

needs.what: a player spec (or a for_each_player option) that iterates every living player in turn order beginning with the effect's controller -- what join_forces already does internally via state.turn_order(ctx.controller) -- so for_each_player can say "starting with you, each player ...". With it the card is: self_enters trigger -> for_each_player over that ordering, body a choose_permanents with objects {zone: battlefield, controller: opponent, any_types: [Artifact, Enchantment], count: 1, optional: true, chooser: {binding: each_player}} as 'chosen' (the binding accumulates across iterations), then destroy {binding: chosen}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: for_each_player resolves players through select_players, and 'each_player'/'all' return state.alive() in seat order, not turn order from the controller; no player spec offers a controller-first ordering. The order is not cosmetic: each later player sees the earlier choices (the join_forces docstring calls seat-order-regardless-of-caster a different card). It only coincides when the controller is seat 0
